queer_characters.name: Dr. Wilhelmina "Wil" Pang
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly described as a closeted lesbian surgeon who gains courage to come out; ends the film engaged to Vivian and accepted by her mother.

queer_characters.name: Vivian Shing
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly Wil's girlfriend and romantic partner in a same-sex relationship; the source text does not assign her a more specific label, so the queer umbrella is used.

queer_creators.name: Alice Wu
queer_creators.notes: Source text states she drew inspiration from her own experience coming out to her mother; no more specific label given, so the queer umbrella is used.

contributor_notes: Plot and reception describe a light-hearted, tender romance with a clearly happy ending (Wil and Vivian engaged, kissing publicly, family acceptance). Wil is explicitly labeled a lesbian; Vivian is explicitly her girlfriend but not given a specific label in the text, so tagged with the queer umbrella. Alice Wu's coming-out experience informing the film supports an own-voices tag, though her specific identity label isn't stated. Themes of family expectation and 'face' present potential tension but no explicit homophobia/violence is described in the source. 'period-piece' applied loosely as a 2004 contemporary setting; a maintainer may wish to remove it. Please verify subtitle availability and Vivian's/Wu's identity labels against additional sources.
